package main

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"strings"

	corev1 "k8s.io/api/core/v1"
	metav1 "k8s.io/apimachinery/pkg/apis/meta/v1"
	"k8s.io/apiserver/pkg/admission"
	"k8s.io/client-go/informers"
	"k8s.io/client-go/kubernetes/fake"
	core "k8s.io/kubernetes/pkg/apis/core"
	v1 "k8s.io/kubernetes/pkg/apis/core/v1"
	"k8s.io/kubernetes/pkg/apis/core/validation"
	"k8s.io/kubernetes/plugin/pkg/admission/priority"
)

type testCase struct {
	Name             string
	Pod              corev1.Pod
	RejectPreemption bool
}

func main() {
	body, err := os.ReadFile(os.Args[1])
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	var cases []testCase
	if err := json.Unmarshal(body, &cases); err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	client := fake.NewClientset()
	plugin := priority.NewPlugin()
	plugin.SetExternalKubeClientSet(client)
	plugin.SetExternalKubeInformerFactory(informers.NewSharedInformerFactory(client, 0))
	if err := plugin.ValidateInitialization(); err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	for _, tc := range cases {
		v1.SetObjectDefaults_Pod(&tc.Pod)
		var pod core.Pod
		if err := v1.Convert_v1_Pod_To_core_Pod(&tc.Pod, &pod, nil); err != nil {
			panic(err)
		}
		attrs := admission.NewAttributesRecord(&pod, nil, corev1.SchemeGroupVersion.WithKind("Pod"), pod.Namespace, pod.Name, corev1.SchemeGroupVersion.WithResource("pods"), "", admission.Create, &metav1.CreateOptions{}, false, nil)
		err := plugin.Admit(context.Background(), attrs, nil)
		if tc.RejectPreemption {
			if err == nil || !strings.Contains(err.Error(), "PreemptionPolicy (Never)") {
				panic(fmt.Sprintf("%s: invalid preemption was not refused: %v", tc.Name, err))
			}
		} else {
			if err != nil {
				panic(fmt.Sprintf("%s: priority admission: %v", tc.Name, err))
			}
			if errs := validation.ValidatePodCreate(&pod, validation.PodValidationOptions{}); len(errs) != 0 {
				panic(fmt.Sprintf("%s: Pod validation: %v", tc.Name, errs))
			}
		}
		fmt.Println("PASS", tc.Name)
	}
}
